## Files

The lab itself is `Lab_03_GLMs` in <https://github.com/iedaejin/bam-statmod-labs>. These scripts run the same steps on other data sets.

- `11-binary-toolkit.Rmd` / `.R` — `MASS::Pima.tr` / `Pima.te`: odds ratios with profile intervals, LR test for a block, sensitivity/specificity/cost functions, thresholds chosen on training data and evaluated on test data, a calibration check.
- `11-count-toolkit.Rmd` / `.R` — `MASS::Insurance`: Poisson rate model with offset `log(Holders)`, dispersion statistic, Cameron–Trivedi test, quasi-Poisson and negative binomial for comparison, randomized quantile residuals, expected zeros, Cook's distance.
